confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Penang price levels; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are reasonably grounded, while hotel rates vary by district (George Town versus Batu Ferringhi) and season and could be off by a meaningful margin. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of Penang bar and by-the-glass wine pricing is weak. July is treated as a non-peak shoulder period with no event premium modeled.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned from George Town's heritage core and the Batu Ferringhi/Tanjung Bungah beach area, weighed against Malaysian peers such as Melaka and Kuala Lumpur and against mid-priced Southeast Asian heritage cities such as Chiang Mai for budget tiers. No single comparable city was used as a direct price source.
